name: pulihin-video
description: Rakitan video demo PULIHIN (Remotion). Terpisah dari aplikasi di root repo.

scripts.studio: npm run scan && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render:final: npm run scan && remotion render src/index.ts PulihinDemo out/pulihin-demo-final.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=192k --concurrency=2 --gl=angle --props=props/tanpa-subtitle.json && node scripts/normalisasi-audio.mjs out/pulihin-demo-final.mp4
scripts.render:final-en: npm run scan && remotion render src/index.ts PulihinDemo out/pulihin-demo-final-en.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=192k --concurrency=2 --gl=angle && node scripts/normalisasi-audio.mjs out/pulihin-demo-final-en.mp4
